title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 23 JULY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 22 July 2026 A few showers will occur in coastal areas of the Western and North-western provinces and Galle district during the morning. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Northern, North-central provinces and in Hambantota district.
